identity.name: Priya Raman
identity.title: GenAI Architect & Engineer
identity.narrative: Priya is a seasoned technology professional with 18+ years of record-breaking performance in building enterprise-scale solutions across Healthcare, Mobile, and Retail domains. She surgically transitioned from deep systems engineering (Senior Mobile Solution Architect / Principal Engineer I) to leading production-grade Generative AI. She doesn't just build POCs; she architects, implements, and deploys observable, reliable reasoning engines in the Cloud.
identity.leadership_philosophy: Priya leads through 'Architectural Empathy'—bridging the gap between stakeholders and deep technical execution. Having led teams at CVS Health and McDonalds, she treats AI agents not just as code, but as enterprise assets that require strict observability (Telemetry Gravity) and cost-efficiency (Nuclear Teardown).
identity.production_philosophy: She believes that 'Reliable Reasoning' is the only path to production GenAI. This means moving beyond simple RAG to 'Triangle of Truth' patterns, where every AI output is cross-referenced against literal truth, historical heuristic, and grounded context.

career_timeline.impact: Led technical strategy and delivery of multi-agent initiatives for enterprise supply chain platforms. Engineered autonomous multi-modal RAG pipelines leveraging FAISS and Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) to parse complex unstructured documents. Architected intelligent data migration accelerators bridging Oracle PL/SQL with LLM query expansion. Pioneered advanced observability across 3-tier GCP GenAI deployments (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, API Gateway) to ensure high fault tolerance and self-healing QA automation.

Architecting sovereign multi-agent ecosystems and fine-tuned open-source LLMs (Llama 3.1, MLX local inference). Pioneered 'Telemetry Gravity' tied to Arize Phoenix and Custom High-Fidelity Evaluation frameworks. Engineered advanced RAG pipelines and custom MCP servers using Google ADK, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and Vertex AI.
Intensive fellowship specializing in high-fidelity reasoning, Neural Networks, Transfer Learning, and production-grade ML workflows.
Led enterprise-scale architecture for iOS and Android. Reduced app launch from 9 seconds to 300 milliseconds. Pioneered passwordless authentication and led large-scale microservices transformations.
Architected multi-national iOS SDKs used by millions. Managed critical production stability across 5 global regions. Led DAST security remediation and secure payment integrations.
Engineered high-availability mobile systems for retail and healthcare. Applied distributed systems principles now used in modern RAG architectures.
